Frontend updates include lifecycle DTO/API/query composables, moderator toolbar controls, prompt-based MVP move/split/merge flows, cache invalidation, closed/archived composer guard, and route updates after move/merge. Specs added/updated for backend topic lifecycle, moderation audit contracts, frontend lifecycle UI, and forum API wiring.
